objects.name: Crab Nebula
objects.notes: The remnant of a supernova recorded by astronomers in 1054.

objects.name: Messier 2
objects.notes: A dense ancient cluster containing many old stars.

objects.name: Messier 3
objects.notes: One of the brightest globular clusters visible from northern skies.

objects.name: Messier 4
objects.notes: A nearby globular cluster close to Antares.

objects.name: Messier 5
objects.notes: A rich cluster with hundreds of thousands of stars.

objects.name: Butterfly Cluster
objects.notes: Its bright stars form a shape resembling a butterfly.

objects.name: Ptolemy Cluster
objects.notes: A bright open cluster visible to the unaided eye.

objects.name: Lagoon Nebula
objects.notes: A large stellar nursery near the Milky Way core.

objects.name: Hercules Cluster
objects.notes: One of the finest globular clusters in the northern sky.

objects.name: Eagle Nebula
objects.notes: Home of the famous Pillars of Creation.

objects.name: Omega Nebula
objects.notes: Also called the Swan Nebula.

objects.name: Trifid Nebula
objects.notes: Known for its three-lobed appearance.

objects.name: Dumbbell Nebula
objects.notes: One of the easiest planetary nebulae to observe.

objects.name: Andromeda Galaxy
objects.notes: The nearest large spiral galaxy to the Milky Way.

objects.name: Triangulum Galaxy
objects.notes: A nearby face-on spiral galaxy.

objects.name: Orion Nebula
objects.notes: A bright star-forming region visible in Orion's sword.

objects.name: Pleiades
objects.notes: A famous cluster also known as the Seven Sisters.

objects.name: Whirlpool Galaxy
objects.notes: A dramatic interacting spiral galaxy.

objects.name: Ring Nebula
objects.notes: A classic ring-shaped planetary nebula.

objects.name: Sunflower Galaxy
objects.notes: A spiral galaxy with a textured, flocculent structure.

objects.name: Bode's Galaxy
objects.notes: A bright galaxy often paired visually with M82.

objects.name: Cigar Galaxy
objects.notes: A galaxy undergoing intense star formation.

objects.name: Virgo A
objects.notes: Hosts the famous black hole imaged by the Event Horizon Telescope.

objects.name: Owl Nebula
objects.notes: Its dark patches resemble owl eyes.

objects.name: Pinwheel Galaxy
objects.notes: A large face-on spiral galaxy.

objects.name: Sombrero Galaxy
objects.notes: Famous for its bright core and dark dust lane.

objects.name: Messier 110
objects.notes: A satellite galaxy of Andromeda.
